title: Global PIQA: Evaluating Physical Commonsense Reasoning Across 100+ Languages and Cultures

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM accuracy on a physical commonsense reasoning benchmark (Global PIQA) across 116 language varieties to measure performance gaps and disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages.

Evaluating models on a hand-crafted, non-translated dataset where the majority of examples reference culturally-specific elements (e.g., local foods, customs, traditions) to assess reasoning capabilities outside of Western or Anglocentric contexts.
